drawings.description: le même système de catégories redessiné en perspective : PB au sommet, PBCR, EPCR, PBC, EPC, et en bas PB $\to$ EP ; flèches « recoller collier », « recoller cône », « identité », « contraction $B$ » ; un mot biffé \ill{} à gauche.
drawings.kind: system of categories in perspective (arrow diagram)
drawings.notes: Nodes placed as on the page: PB at the top, PBCR, EPCR, PBC, EPC, and at the bottom PB -> EP. Arrows from the top PB to PBCR (recoller collier, a double stroke), to EPCR (recoller cône), to EPC (identité) and to EP (contraction B); PBCR -> EPCR, PBCR -> PBC, PBC -> EPC, EPCR -> EPC, EPC -> EP (heavy), PBC -> PB (heavy, with a scribble), PB -> EP. The bottom node reads like "PD" on the crop; it is labelled PB after the transcription. The struck word at the left and a second small "identité" by EPC are left out.

drawings.description: deux petits carrés, marqués $\varepsilon$, $s(Q)$ et $\varepsilon^*$, $s(Q^*)$, reliés par $\longleftrightarrow$.
drawings.notes: Two small squares, each preceded by a colon: the first with epsilon and s(Q), the second with epsilon* and s(Q*); the double arrow joining them is written on the next line, below and between them.
Twelve small pencil points arranged roughly in a ring (an irregular grid), as on the page.

drawings.description: deux cases de deux et trois points
drawings.kind: two boxes of two and three points
drawings.notes: Two rounded boxes, one with two points and one with three.

After a colon, a small square with a small x inside and a heavy mark at its upper left corner, a small label above it (read as omega(Q)?, left out), closed by a parenthesis; epsilon, a_Q and Z_Q below.
Between parentheses, after a colon: a small square with both diagonals; epsilon*, a_Q and Z_Q below.

drawings.description: un carré raturé, puis un carré à deux diagonales
drawings.kind: struck square, then a square with two diagonals
drawings.notes: A square covered with crossing-out strokes (drawn grey), then a square with both diagonals heavy.

drawings.description: petit carré à diagonale, en partie raturé
drawings.kind: small square with a diagonal, partly struck
drawings.notes: A small square with a heavy diagonal ending in two points and a small x inside; a struck scribble to its left (grey) and a heavy vertical bar to its right.

Two ovals, the first with points (one heavy) marked 2 below, the second with three points marked 3. The first oval seems to hold three marks (one large, two small) where the transcription counts 2; the label 2 is his.
Two adjacent triangles drawn with loose hatching, their vertices thickened. The outlines are a reading of overlapping hatch strokes.

drawings.description: icosaèdre en perspective, sommets marqués $u, u', v, v', a, b$, faces hachurées.
drawings.notes: The visible front of an icosahedron: the upper vertex u, the middle a, b, the lower u', side vertices labelled v (right) and v' (left), and an outline arc over the top and down to a bottom vertex (pencil). Hatched faces: the three faces round a, b. Edges heavy where he inked them (l-u, l-a, a-b). Two further small labels at the upper left and upper right are not readable and are left out; the edges behind are not drawn.

drawings.description: plusieurs croquis de tétraèdres et d'octaèdres, en partie hachurés, sommets marqués $a, b, c, c', u$ ; un carré à diagonales ; le nombre 100 en marge.
drawings.kind: page of sketches of tetrahedra and octahedra
drawings.notes: Whole lower half of the page, schematic: a square with both diagonals and points at its corners (upper left); small tetrahedra and octahedra, some hatched, one inked heavy (centre right) with labels c', c, u; one with a, b, c; a long bipyramid with a, b at its equator; "100" in the margin. Each small solid is drawn as its visible edges (four-vertex sketches as complete graphs); vertex positions approximate. The lists of letters at the right (ac, bc, ab ...) are text and are left out.
